title: Available to spend
subtitle: An estimate after upcoming spending and money you have set aside.
loadError: Your spending estimate could not be updated. Try again before making a decision.
shortfall: Your plan is short by {{amount}} over this period.
incomplete: More imported data is needed to calculate this estimate.
reserved: Goal savings protected in this balance
contributions: Planned goal contributions over this period
purchaseFits: This fits the current estimate, leaving {{amount}} unallocated.
purchaseExceeds: This exceeds your available amount by {{amount}}.
assumption: Future income is not counted. New spending is reserved on the purchase date; actual bank debits may happen later.
nextIncomeHelp: Optional override for the next payment only. Automatic detection resumes once this date passes.
bufferHelp: Money to leave untouched in addition to your goal savings.
commitmentsHelp: Optional replacement for the imported amount. Automatic calculation resumes when bank or card data changes.
saveError: Could not save these details. Check the values and try again.

reasons.NO_BANK_BALANCE: Connect a bank account and sync its balance.
reasons.MISSING_BANK_BALANCE: A bank account is missing a usable balance. Sync your accounts.
reasons.STALE_BANK_BALANCE: A bank balance is more than seven days old. Sync before using this estimate.
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY: This estimate currently requires all included bank balances to be in shekels.
reasons.NEXT_INCOME_OUTSIDE_HORIZON: Choose a future income date within the next 180 days.
reasons.FORECAST_UNAVAILABLE: The forecast is unavailable. Retry after your next sync.
reasons.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: More transaction history is needed to estimate upcoming spending.
reasons.INCOMPLETE_FORECAST: The forecast does not cover the full planning period. Refresh your data and retry.
reasons.CARD_DATA_MISSING: Sync your card accounts to include their outstanding payments.
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_BANK_CURRENCY: A bank balance is in a foreign currency. This estimate cannot yet combine it with shekels.
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_TRANSACTION_CURRENCY: Recent transactions include amounts charged in a foreign currency. This estimate cannot yet convert them.
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_CARD_CURRENCY: An outstanding card payment is charged in a foreign currency. This estimate cannot yet convert it.
reasons.STALE_CARD_DATA: A card account has not synced successfully in more than seven days. Refresh that account to update outstanding payments.
reasons.INVALID_CARD_AMOUNT: An imported card transaction has no usable amount. Refresh the card account to update it.

automaticHelp: Income dates and card commitments update automatically from your synced data. Only change these if you want to override the estimate.
rollingHelp: No reliable payday pattern yet; using the next 30 days, refreshed automatically.
detectedIncome: Next income detected from recurring payments.
detectedCards: Card commitments calculated from imported billing data.
estimatedCards: Some billing dates are missing. Recent card purchases are reserved conservatively for 45 days.
recentSpendingHelp: A rough estimate based on {{days}} days of imported history. It updates automatically; no setup is needed.
